# GoRASA — Premium Travel Booking Platform

> GoRASA is India's premium travel booking platform offering curated holiday packages, luxury hotels, and flights to 100+ destinations worldwide.

## Key Pages

- `/` — Homepage with featured packages and destinations
- `/hotels` — Hotel search and booking (TBO integration, 500+ chains)
- `/flights` — Flight search and booking (GDS integration)
- `/holidays` — Curated holiday packages by category
- `/destinations/[slug]` — Destination guides (goa, dubai, bali, maldives, thailand, kashmir, singapore, manali)
- `/blog` — Travel blog with expert guides and tips
- `/faq` — Frequently asked questions by category
- `/about` — Company information and trust signals
- `/support` — Help center with AI concierge

## Structured Data Endpoints

- `/api/public/packages` — All active packages in JSON
- `/api/public/destinations` — All destinations with metadata
- `/api/public/faq` — All FAQs in structured format
